u0: The agent is in the ordinary progress phase: it is not at the exit and has no fallen box left unrecovered. This is the starting state and also the phase returned to after picking up a fallen box. The remaining objective is to reach the exit while holding the box; if the box falls on the way, it must be picked up again. Arriving at the exit with the box completes the task, while arriving empty-handed leaves the carrying requirement pending.
u1: The box has fallen and is not currently in the agent's hands, and the agent is not at the exit. The immediate objective is to pick the box up again, which returns it to ordinary progress. If the agent instead reaches the exit while still empty-handed, the fall remains unrecovered and the task moves to an unresolved exit situation. Until the box is picked up, this recovery phase continues.
u2: The agent has reached the exit without holding the box, with no fresh fall on that step and no unrecovered fall pending. The arrival does not satisfy the requirement to be carrying the box at the exit, so completion is still pending. Holding the box would satisfy that requirement and finish the task; otherwise the situation remains unresolved.
u3: The agent has reached the exit while holding the box. Any fall that occurred has already been followed by picking the box back up, so both the carrying-at-exit requirement and the fall-recovery requirement are satisfied. All task objectives are complete.
u4: The agent has reached the exit while empty-handed, and a fall has left the box unretrieved. Both the requirement to recover after the fall and the requirement to be carrying the box at the exit remain unsatisfied. The only way to finish from this state is for the box to end up in the agent's hands; there is no return to ordinary room progress.
